Press begins a 480-frame fade and latches; a later release clears the latch and begins a 240-frame fade-up.
Intervals from 250 through 1500 ms update accepted tempo; other gaps are ignored.
Encoder hold requests Reset; a second request restarts the 240-frame fade-down.
